 "I am living in a nightmare": Ethan Klein's alleged affair gets revealed by wife and podcast co-host Hila Klein
 Rajarshi Deb Updated 2026년 10월 23일 금 오전 8:26 UTC 0 Hila Klein and his son ©Instagram/@kleinhila H3 podcast co-host and Ethan Klein's wife, Hila Klein, had reportedly alleged that her husband was having an affair. She felt that the betrayal felt immeasurable. Recently, she posted a three-paragraph update on Instagram where she revealed,
 "I am living in a nightmare I can't wake up from. My husband has been having an affair. I have been fed lie after lie after lie for months. I am tired of lies. Here is the truth."
 Hila further explained that the person she loved and trusted for 20 years disappeared overnight. She said that her husband had been her safe place, partner in marriage, parenting, and business partner and her only family on this side of the world.
 Hila admitted that she couldn't make sense of what happened and didn't know what came next because she had never faced this situation before. She described herself as being in survival mode trying to handle separation, co-parenting, and unbearable heartbreak.
 Continue reading more about the story.
 Hila Klein allegedly revealed her husband's betrayal
 The wife of Ethan Klein, Hila Klein, allegedly posted on her Instagram account that her husband was having an affair and revealed that the betrayal she felt was beyond measure. She explained that she was living a nightmare and she couldn't wake up from it. Hila elaborated,
 Advertisement
 "I am living in a nightmare I can't wake up from."
 Hila further mentioned,
 "The betrayal I feel is immeasurable. The person I loved and trusted for 20 years evaporated overnight. He was my safe place, my partner in marriage, parenting, and business. My only family on this side of the world."
 She added that her focus was now on caring for herself and her children and advised others to trust their instincts, trust themselves, and leave their partners if they were not being treated right.
 Hila Klein alleged Ethan Klein had a months-long affair
 Hila shared that she sensed something was wrong and tried to ask Ethan Klein questions and share her concerns and feelings. However, she only received dismissive replies and no action from her husband. She said that the issues that troubled her continued, and Ethan did nothing to change them. Hila shared,
 "I could sense something was wrong. I tried to ask him questions and share my concerns and hurt feelings. But I was met with dismissive answers and no action."
 Ethan's wife further admitted that she trusted him because she loved him, and therefore, she stopped questioning him and began to doubt herself, her instincts, and even her sanity. Eventually, she discovered he was lying, and she decided that she was done, but the lies continued. She explained that their relationship started with a kiss and turned into emotional cheating.
 After Hila forced Ethan Klein to admit the truth, Hila alleged he admitted to an affair for more than six months, though she believed she still didn't know the full extent.
